text:
tanya: Quick plan — small PLG launch to test which activation nudge moves timezone-heavy signups. three arms: (A) 50 credits + two prompt templates on first-success, (B) no credits but guaranteed 30m office hours + checklist, (C) 75 credits delivered only after webinar attendance + post-webinar challenge. primary metric: time_to_first_success (hrs). secondary: 7d retention + token spend. budget cap $2.5k.

ben: routing: randomize at signup, persist. grant-on-first-success for credit arms to reduce farming. whitelist corporate emails. @growth-bot can you spin this up?

growth-bot: experiment created: id tz-surge-2026-06-21. assignment: randomized at signup, stored in user.experiments.tz_surge. grant triggers on event:first_success. whitelist: email_domain != gmail.com,yahoo.com. doc: https://redwood.internal/experiments/tz-surge-2026-06-21

michelle: analytics: tag cohort with experiment_id and arm, add webinar_attended boolean, first_success_ts, and referral_source. will do time-to-event + retention; publish dashboard by Fri.

ash: creative will draft 3 subject lines + 2 hero variants. also a short landing blurb that explains "earn credits by showing up" for the webinar arm. posting comps by Wed. :sparkles:

ben: ops note: set per-user cap 75, expire credits after 14 days, global spend cap $2.5k. payload for grant lambda: ```json
{"experiment_id":"tz-surge-2026-06-21","arm":"credits","credits":50,"cap_per_user":75}
```

data-bot: ramp plan scheduled: start with 250 randomized users Mon 09:00 UTC. alert to #marketing-ops if spend > $400 in first 24h.

michelle: will stratify results by webinar_attended and referral_source. want a small control (~150 users) with just webinar invite + tips for baseline.

tanya: final checklist: creative Wed EOD, routing + infra Fri noon, analytics tags before launch. announce go/no-go by Fri 3pm. keep updates here.

ben: noted.

growth-bot: reminder ping scheduled for 1741188000.
